absent: Locking discipline for verifier environment, map descriptors, BTF objects, bpf pointer targets and bsg jobs.
Full verifier and iterator and bsg job state machines beyond scratch set transitions.
Public entry points and calling contexts beyond inline predicates and copy helpers.
Complete failure modes for map poison handling, hardened usercopy diagnostics and BTF validation.
Memory layout and ownership for external structures referenced but not defined in these fragments.
Meaning of omitted kernel function flag bits and omitted BTF show and info values.
Concrete sorting and fixup procedures for kernel function descriptor tables.

findings.text: The helper type_flag isolates the modifier portion of a register type by excluding the base mask. The set BPF_REG_TRUSTED_MODIFIERS groups allocation with trusted and non owning reference marks. The predicate bpf_type_has_unsafe_modifiers reports any remaining modifier outside that trusted set as unsafe.

Classification predicates distinguish register pointer families. bpf_is_ptr_to_mem_or_btf_id accepts memory and BTF identity kinds. type_is_map_ptr accepts map and map key and map value kinds. type_is_pkt_pointer accepts packet and packet metadata kinds. type_is_sk_pointer accepts socket family kinds. type_is_ptr_alloc_obj requires BTF identity with allocation and without untrusted marking, while type_is_non_owning_ref adds a non owning mark. type_may_be_null tests a nullability mark. bpf_may_fault_on_deref requires fault protection for BTF identity or any untrusted marking.

resolve_prog_type prefers a saved destination type for extension programs and otherwise keeps the direct program type. bpf_prog_check_recur varies recursion handling by resolved type, distinguishing tracing with iterator attachment, structure operations with private stack use, and an exemption for LSM and syscall programs with a default positive outcome otherwise. bpf_prog_has_arena_ctx_arg scans context argument descriptors for arena pointer kind.

Precision tracking uses register and stack slot scratch sets with clean and fully scratched conditions. mark_reg_scratched and mark_stack_slot_scratched set one entry, reg_scratched and stack_slot_scratched test one entry, verifier_state_scratched reports whether either set is non empty, mark_verifier_state_clean clears both sets, and mark_verifier_state_scratched sets all entries.

bpf_stack_narrow_access_ok validates narrow stack access by offset alignment to register size, applying a width based adjustment on big endian. insn_is_gotox identifies register based unconditional jumps by requiring jump class with jump always operation and register source mode, relying on the field extractors BPF_CLASS and BPF_OP and BPF_SRC.

Small verification descriptors carry focused state. bpf_map_desc pairs a map reference with a numeric handle. bpf_dynptr_desc carries dynamic pointer kind with identity and parent identity. ref_obj_desc carries identity with parent identity and a count. arg_raw_mem_desc carries a register number with a size. ret_mem_desc carries a size with a found mark. arg_constant_desc carries a value with a found mark. bpf_call_arg_meta aggregates these plus BTF handles, function identity, release register, return type identity, subprogram index, kfunc only mutability and flag and prototype and name and constant and BTF argument detail plus list and tree and iterator slots, and helper only size and key and return BTF and field and raw memory detail.
bpf_is_iter_next_kfunc reports iterator next behavior from call metadata flags. bpf_is_kfunc_sleepable reports sleep permission from the same flags.

Map key state reserves bit 63 for BPF_MAP_KEY_POISON and bit 62 for BPF_MAP_KEY_SEEN. Packet offset bound MAX_PACKET_OFF is 0xffff. Caller saved register count CALLER_SAVED_REGS is 6. Kernel function descriptor bound MAX_KFUNC_DESCS is 256. bpf_reg_arg_type distinguishes source operand use, destination operand use with marking, and destination check without marking.

bpf_map_ptr_poisoned and bpf_map_ptr_unpriv expose poison and unprivileged marks from auxiliary pointer state. bpf_map_key_poisoned tests the poison bit, bpf_map_key_unseen tests absence of the seen bit, and bpf_map_key_immediate returns the stored immediate with both reserved bits masked out.

bpf_kfunc_desc records calling convention model with prototype, function identity, immediate, offset and resolved address. bpf_kfunc_desc_tab holds a count followed by a flexible descriptor array that is ordered by function identity and offset during verification and later reordered by immediate and offset for lookup, growing one entry at a time.

bpfptr_t aliases the socket pointer abstraction over kernel and user spaces. bpfptr_is_kernel and sockptr_is_kernel test the space selector. KERNEL_BPFPTR and USER_BPFPTR build each variant, make_bpfptr selects between them from a raw integer using u64_to_user_ptr for the user case, bpfptr_is_null tests emptiness in the active space, and bpfptr_add advances within the active space.

Copy helpers branch on address space. copy_from_bpfptr_offset and copy_from_bpfptr read from user memory with user copy and from kernel memory with faulting kernel copy. copy_to_bpfptr_offset delegates to copy_to_sockptr_offset which writes to user or kernel memory accordingly. strncpy_from_bpfptr preserves the same space branch for bounded strings. kvmemdup_bpfptr_noprof and kvmemdup_bpfptr allocate then copy and report allocation shortage or copy fault with error pointers. User paths rely on copy_from_user and copy_to_user.

copy_from_user and copy_to_user first validate size with check_copy_size, which checks builtin object size, reports overflow through copy_overflow, rejects oversize lengths and invokes check_object_size. Hardened validation is active only when enabled and may compile to an empty operation. Validation failure returns the full requested length. Overflow reporting depends on bug support.

bsg_buffer describes a payload with length plus scatter list count and list. bsg_job carries device linkage, reference counting, timeout, request and reply buffers with lengths, request and reply payloads, result and received length, bidirectional request linkage and driver private storage. Reply length is capacity on entry and must be updated to actual reply size on completion. bsg_job_fn and bsg_timeout_fn define job and timeout handling, while bsg_sg_io_fn and bsg_uring_cmd_fn define queue level SG IO and uring command handling.

Kernel function attributes use distinct bits. KF_ACQUIRE is bit 0 for acquire, KF_RELEASE is bit 1 for release, KF_RET_NULL is bit 2 for nullable return, KF_SLEEPABLE is bit 5 for sleep permission, KF_DESTRUCTIVE is bit 6 for destructive action, KF_RCU is bit 7 for RCU or trusted arguments, KF_ITER_NEW is bit 8 for iterator construction, KF_ITER_NEXT is bit 9 for iterator advance, KF_ITER_DESTROY is bit 10 for iterator destruction, KF_RCU_PROTECTED is bit 11 for RCU protection, KF_FASTCALL is bit 12 for fastcall, KF_ARENA_RET is bit 13 for arena return, KF_ARENA_ARG1 is bit 14 and KF_ARENA_ARG2 is bit 15 for arena arguments, KF_IMPLICIT_ARGS is bit 16 for implicit arguments, KF_SPINLOCK_SAFE is bit 17 for spinlock regions, KF_PERFMON is bit 18 for perfmon capability.

Display control reuses compact, no name, raw pointer and zero base forms for BTF_SHOW_COMPACT and BTF_SHOW_NONAME and BTF_SHOW_PTR_RAW and BTF_SHOW_ZERO, with BTF_SHOW_UNSAFE as bit 4. Include guards _LINUX_BTF_H and _LINUX_BPFPTR_H and _BLK_BSG_ and _LINUX_BSG_H mark their headers.

btf_kfunc_filter_t is a predicate over program and function identity. btf_kfunc_id_set pairs an owner module with an identifier set and filter. btf_id_dtor_kfunc pairs a type identity with a destructor function identity. btf_struct_meta pairs a type identity with a record, and btf_struct_metas holds a count followed by a flexible array of such pairs.

BTF kind predicates compare stored kind tags. btf_type_is_ptr and btf_is_ptr accept pointer kind, btf_type_is_int and btf_is_int accept integer kind, btf_type_is_enum and btf_is_enum accept enum kind, btf_is_enum64 accepts 64 bit enum kind, btf_is_any_enum accepts either enum form, btf_type_is_scalar accepts integer or enum, btf_type_is_struct accepts struct or union while __btf_type_is_struct accepts only struct, btf_is_composite accepts struct or union, btf_type_is_array and btf_is_array accept array kind, plus distinct checks for forward, typedef, volatile, function, function prototype, variable and type tag kinds. btf_kind exposes the kind tag, btf_kind_core_compat compares kinds with enum forms considered compatible, btf_type_vlen exposes element count, and for_each_member and for_each_vsi iterate members and section entries.

Integer detail helpers inspect the word after the type header. btf_type_is_small_int requires integer kind with size within eight bytes, btf_type_is_signed_int requires a signed encoding mark, btf_int_encoding and btf_int_offset and btf_int_bits expose encoding and offset and width subfields, btf_enum64_value combines high and low halves into a 64 bit value, and str_is_empty treats missing or empty strings as empty.

Instruction field extraction uses low three bits for BPF_CLASS, high nibble for BPF_OP and bit 3 for BPF_SRC. BTF kind extraction uses bits 24 to 30 for BTF_INFO_KIND. Integer detail extraction uses bits 24 to 27 for BTF_INT_ENCODING, bits 16 to 23 for BTF_INT_OFFSET and low eight bits for BTF_INT_BITS.

The marker __bpf_kfunc tags retained non cloned non inlined kernel functions. __bpf_kfunc_start_defs and __bpf_kfunc_end_defs bracket global function definitions with diagnostic suppression for missing declarations and prototypes, reused by __bpf_hook_start and __bpf_hook_end. BTF_TYPE_EMIT and BTF_TYPE_EMIT_ENUM reference a type or enumerator for emission without runtime effect. stringify_struct validates a structure type and yields its name as text.

Poisoned map pointer or key state indicates unsafe reuse and must not be treated as valid. Unseen key state indicates no observation yet. Unprivileged pointer state indicates restricted context. In block SCSI generic handling, reply length and result and received length must reflect actual completion, since callers rely on the updated reply size rather than entry capacity.
